headline: Nevish Line Seethes as Palantine Berm Erupts Anew
war_summary: Since the evening edition the tempo has quickened in the north while the southern hollow has fallen silent. Palantine Berm now leads the wire with 15 changes in two hours and 47 on the day, holding seven Warden posts with Leiri Hermanni and Windburn Landing most listed, last heard at 20:57, with day losses of 972 Colonial and 937 Warden. The Weathered Expanse follows with six in two hours and 23 on the day to stand three Warden, five Colonial and one unheld about Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, also last heard at 20:57, with 4,211 Colonial and 7,319 Warden casualties on the day and both rates accelerating. The Nevish Line remains the busiest day sector at 50 changes, two in two hours, now six Warden, one Colonial and one unheld about Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, last heard at 21:16. Marban Hollow, Stlican Shelf, Kuura Strand and Callahan's Passage record no changes in the last two hours, though Marban Hollow still shows 1,810 Colonial and 3,347 Warden losses in that span.
